answer_1.quote: We focus on the task of generating a simile given a literal input. ... We propose a novel way of creating parallel corpora and a transfer-learning approach for generating similes.
datasets: Reddit WRITINGPROMPTS and FUNNY (self‑labeled similes, 87,843 pairs)
Human‑written test set of 150 literal utterances with expert similes

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU-1, BLEU-2 and BERTScore of our system compared to the three baselines. ... For novelty, SCOPE can still generate novel content 88% of the time.

answer_4.quote: We hired Turkers on MTurk to rate outputs from the 4 systems and 2 humans. Each criteria was rated on a scale from 1 (not at all) to 5 (very).
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated simile on Creativity, Relevance1 (property relevance), Relevance2 (topic relevance), and Overall Quality using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
